bio: Chiara Bembo, once merely an ambitious daughter of a wood carver, has established herself as a formidable commercial force within Venice's mercantile landscape. Having expanded from her initial ventures—a thriving bakery and an artisan brokerage stall—she now commands significant capital and operates a prosperous granary that serves as a vital link in the city's complex supply chain.
